purpose: Test no-cost standard GitHub-hosted macos-15 arm64 Apple Silicon runner for usable non-software Chromium WebGL2. No owned machine or paid xlarge runner required. Feasibility only.
trigger: one original pull_request.opened, attempt 1 only; fixed two-case order; no retries, selecting only favorable modes, or benchmark rescores
checks: actual Chromium version and host OS/arch
GLSL triangle draw and pixel readback
decision: Only an unmasked nonsoftware WebGL2 renderer with correct real pixel readback is provisionally usable. A browser-reported hardware-like renderer is not proof of physical GPU provenance; renderer software/fallback is not eligible. No FPS, timing, product-gate or code acceptance measured.
followup: If standard runner provides usable acceleration, separately preregister identical-package A/A measurement under controlled conditions; only that can establish precision before a real candidate/baseline run.
comparisonPrior: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu SwiftShader/Mesa identical-build A/A had high false-block rate. The already merged physical readiness script required an owned self-hosted macOS machine; this separate feasibility check does not run it.
